title.narrative: Strengthening Capacities for Crisis Assessment, Recovery Planning and Peacebuilding

description.narrative: Contract related to: Strengthening Capacities for Crisis Assessment, Recovery Planning and Peacebuilding - The Action entitled ¿Underpinning multilateral solutions to sustain and build peace¿ focuses on support to multilateralism as a means to foster peace and security and as a cross-cutting theme of the EU¿s approach to conflict and crisis and threats to peace and security. It includes a renewed support to the UN-EU partnership on insider mediation, which seeks to increase awareness of and knowledge about insider mediation. The Action also intends to reinforce its contribution to the tripartite cooperation between the EU, the UN and the World Bank on post-crisis assessments. This will be achieved through the provision of technical assistance, capacity building and support national and regional stakeholders to roll-out post-crisis assessment methodologies.
